name: envilder
description: Integrate Envilder into an application: map its environment variables to AWS SSM Parameter Store or Azure Key Vault secrets in a versioned envilder.json, validate the map file, and use that one contract for local development (envilder exec or pull), GitHub Actions (macalbert/envilder/github-action) and runtime SDKs (.NET, Python, Node.js). Use when the user mentions Envilder or envilder.json, or wants to move .env files or hardcoded secrets to AWS SSM or Azure Key Vault, or load cloud secrets in CI or at runtime. Never reads or prints secret values.
